description: One catalog app with its install fields and install guidance (which values to ask the user for; apps that need a secret can only be installed in the dashboard). Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.
